fixed_2x2.label: 2x2: weights
fixed_2x2.resource_lifetime: same full explicit uses/first/last graph for both methods
fixed_2x2.prefetch: next block, wait for readiness; safe slot reuse

median.resource_lifetime: same full uses/first/last graph and same resource inventory for both profiles
median.scope: all registered resources and nodes, T5 through MP4
median.not_implemented: full-pipeline resource scheduler, calibration and trace integration
median.label: FlexGen-inspired: median
median.estimates: median preparation, transfer and compute duration per matching resource/node bucket
median.objective: minimum predicted end-to-end time under fixed RAM/VRAM budgets
median.provenance: our median-based FlexGen-inspired profile; FlexGen paper does not prescribe median timing
median.implementation_status: requires resource placement/migration redesign; existing implementation only varies weight windows

guarded.resource_lifetime: same full uses/first/last graph and same resource inventory for both profiles
guarded.scope: all registered resources and nodes, T5 through MP4
guarded.not_implemented: full-pipeline resource scheduler, calibration and trace integration
guarded.label: FlexGen-inspired + reserve: max observed transfer, min observed compute
guarded.estimates: observed maximum preparation/transfer durations; observed minimum compute durations to estimate earliest demand; retain complete calibration traces
guarded.objective: prioritize zero predicted resource deadline misses under observed calibration scenarios, then end-to-end latency; prefetch as early as legal when spare memory exists
guarded.constraints: same memory budgets, safe slot reuse and dependency/lifetime constraints; mark candidate infeasible if lead time or capacity is insufficient
guarded.guarantee: observed extrema are not bounds on future runtimes; readiness events remain mandatory; measure deadline misses and actual resource waits
guarded.implementation_status: requires resource placement/migration redesign; existing implementation only varies weight windows

execution.calibration: Collect one shared dataset on diverse held-out-from-evaluation prompts at 480x832; report calibration cost once separately; derive and freeze both profiles before evaluation
execution.compilation: common prepared cache for both methods; record cache state and versions; no compilation mixed into steady statistics
execution.budget_rule: choose and freeze numerical budgets before calibration/measurement; same budgets for both conditions
execution.run_rule: do not run until both integrations, telemetry, budgets and preflight validation are ready
execution.calibration_estimator: phase/resource/node costs, median or max loading/min compute; same raw calibration dataset
execution.profile_fit: DiT compute timing uses chunks >=8, excluding compile/first-full-cache samples; retain all raw rows
execution.candidate_scope: Independent pinned/GPU windows 1..4 for T5/DiT; other resource placements fixed by supported runtime. No arbitrary library/context/workspace swapping.

measurement.end_to_end: parent process launch timestamp -> child writer close, includes import/loading/T5/generation/decode/writer; calibration separate
measurement.time_to_first_frame: process entry -> first decoded frame submitted to writer
measurement.chunk_delivery: wall intervals between completed chunk deliveries including denoising, decoding and writer work; first chunk reported separately
measurement.steady_chunks: zero-based chunk indices >= 7, identical in both profiles
measurement.quantile_method: linear within each run, median of per-run metrics across prompts; memory peak worst across runs; raw runs retained
measurement.vram_allocated: PyTorch live tensor bytes, excludes allocator reserve and driver/library allocations
measurement.vram_reserved: PyTorch allocator reserved bytes, separate from allocated
measurement.vram_device_used_free: device total/free from NVML; includes other processes; record idle GPU before each run
measurement.vram_peak: allocator maximum for entire run; do not reset at phase boundaries; supplement with sampled device-used peak
measurement.ram_process: RSS and Windows private commit; sampled RSS peak labelled sampled; mmap pages included
measurement.ram_system: available system RAM, baseline/minimum/after cleanup; not process-owned RAM
measurement.pinning: current/peak active pinned bytes and reserved pinned bytes, if runtime exposes them; unknown is null
measurement.trace: same instrumentation both methods; record acquire, prepare, transfer, ready, execute, release and timestamps
measurement.resource_deadlines: record when resource was needed versus ready, miss count, total/max GPU dependency waiting; distinguish actual waits from CPU being ahead of queued GPU work
measurement.deadline_target: zero observed resource-readiness stalls; not a guarantee for unseen runs

inventory.count_rule: logical resources counted once; bytes deduplicated by backing storage; physical replicas counted separately
inventory.dynamic_rule: record dynamic KV/workspace/decoder-state sizes over time; unknown library workspace is not zero

compare: decoded frames before lossy MP4 encoding
correctness.fallback_tolerance: must be fixed before measurement if exact equality is not expected; no post-hoc tolerance
forbid: slot overwrite before last CUDA user

limits: 24 distinct held-out prompt/seed triples, one run/condition, balanced condition order. Power assumes strong (.8 win probability) effect; no guarantee. Cost optimizer supports only legal staging windows; all other registered resources have fixed lifetimes/placements. Internal CUDA workspaces/library bytes remain untracked overhead.

hardware.vram_budget: set below total after accounting for runtime and other consumers

calibration.datasets: one shared raw dataset, two derived profiles; evaluation prompt held out

statistics.unit: distinct held-out prompt and assigned seed
statistics.test: exact two-sided paired sign test around speedup 1.05; Holm adjustment for two contrasts
statistics.ties: abs(speedup - 1.05) <= 1e-6, omitted from sign test; report count
statistics.power_assumption: independent units; probability of exceeding 1.05x speedup is .8, no ties
statistics.reject_rule: all 24 triples complete; Holm-adjusted p<.05; more wins than losses
statistics.decision: reject or do not reject; no guarantee of significant results
statistics.secondary: guarded vs median, chunk quantiles, resource waits, memory, quality equality: descriptive

resource_migration.scope: self KV + tensor metadata, cross KV, decoder weights/state, recache window, latent archive
resource_migration.not_implemented: cost-based placement search and asynchronous resource prefetch
